metric: Open-source Dataform projects and BigQuery SQL, copied at pinned commits. Each project is loaded whole; every file goes through the cleanup rules and the formatter. A failure is a crash, a change accepted without a proof, a changed backticked name, or a literal ref() that is not a graph edge.
correctness: 0 failures; dependencies 217/217 literal ref() and config dependencies found
performance: 63.7 s for every project and stage
caveats: Eight projects only, chosen for licence and feature spread, not at random. dbt projects (Jinja) are left out because KumoSQL does not render Jinja. basedosdados is a 40-file sample of 536 near-identical view definitions, renamed after their folders because every file is called publish.sql. Statement and column counts cover query models; operations and generated SQL that only running JavaScript can produce are counted as gaps, not failures. No results are compared against BigQuery. A changed statement that holds a JavaScript constant (${sp.entropy}) stays unproven until the SQLX is compiled (docs/proof-safeguards.md).
held_out: First run: two bugs found and fixed on this corpus (a long header comment hid a statement's kind, so all 40 basedosdados views were unread; a wrong count in the unparsed-operations message). The corpus is not held out.
